## Email routing scenarios (SEND)

> Live routing contracts for email-marketing goals — `commands/auto.md` consumes these the same way as the other blocks. `/aaron-marketing:auto` routes email work through `/aaron-marketing:email` (SEND-loop phases setup / engage / nurture / deliver, `--phase` to force one; boundary rules in [aaron-product-api-contract.md](../aaron-product-api-contract.md)). Same `eval-case` schema. Keyless Tier 1: skills score from the user's own ESP / GA4 / ecommerce exports plus the DMARC aggregate report. Only `email-quality-auditor` computes EQS and enforces the vetoes.
